name: Intercontinental Kunming
positioning: InterContinental Kunming is a lakeside hotel by Dian Lake in Kunming's Xishan District, with panoramic Dianchi views, balcony rooms, select rooms and suites with a private hot spring, a lawn by the lake and a butterfly theme throughout
best_for: Travelers who want a lakeside base by Dian Lake rather than downtown Kunming
Couples who want a balcony room or a suite with a private hot spring
Guests exploring West Mountain and Yunnan Ethnic Village

facts.text: The hotel sits by Dian Lake, at No. 5 Yijing Road in Kunming's Xishan District.
Guest rooms and suites have panoramic views of Dianchi, also known as Dian Lake.
Most rooms have large balconies, and select suites have private recreation rooms.
Premium Rooms and One Bedroom Suites may include a private hot spring.
Alongside Dian Lake, the hotel has a lawn and a spacious outdoor area used for leisure, weddings and social gatherings.
A butterfly theme runs through the whole hotel, echoed by the Butterfly Bar.
Shang Tao Chinese Restaurant serves Cantonese dishes and Yunnan flavors, and its seven private rooms are named after phrases from ancient poems praising butterflies.
The heated indoor pool at the ZEST Fitness Center has expansive views.
Club InterContinental offers complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails.
Yunnan Ethnic Village, about 2 kilometers from the hotel on the shore of Dianchi, showcases the cultures and traditions of the 26 nations in Yunnan.
Kunming is nicknamed Spring City for its mild and pleasant climate.

considerations.text: The hotel is about 40 kilometers from Kunming Airport.
The hotel is by Dian Lake in Xishan District, close to Dianchi and Xishan rather than in downtown Kunming.
